finding.original_local_issue: The original WP1111 helper resolved a referenced path before checking candidate.is_symlink(), which is locally incapable of proving that the lexical reference was link-free.
finding.composed_system_counterfinding: The composed WP1111 evaluator first invokes the canonical release-integrity verifier, which rejects symlink files/directories across the manifest-bound payload before metadata-reference checks. Therefore ordinary post-build symlink substitution does not establish a reachable bypass of the composed static gate.
finding.parallel_resolution: Trigger-4 retained lexical component checking as defense-in-depth and isolated its unit falsifiers from release-manifest authority. Repository-hosted component CI then passed at the exact accepted source.

authority_model.role: canonical full-payload static integrity and symlink prohibition for manifest-bound release artifacts
defense-in-depth validation of lexical metadata references; may fail earlier/more specifically but must not become a second release-manifest authority
separate future/runtime concern; if untrusted mutable traversal exists, use descriptor/kernel-backed confinement rather than assuming static Path validation closes TOCTOU races

external_patterns.result: supports lexical-check-before-resolve when link identity itself is an invariant
prefer forbidding links when not required and keep extraction/live mutation outside static manifest claims

external_patterns.source: Linux openat2 RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS/RESOLVE_BENEATH and Go os.Root
external_patterns.result: do not import for current frozen static gate; revisit only if F2 opens untrusted mutable filesystem paths

counterhypotheses: Defense-in-depth lexical checking may be redundant under the current manifest-bound call chain, but can still protect future helper reuse and produce a local invariant with clearer failure semantics.
Static link-free validation does not prove race-free later access if another process can mutate path components after validation.
The successful repository CI establishes only the accepted component/source scope, not clean-machine, physical-host, runtime, effect, completion or whole-system acceptance.

architecture_delta.reason: The only justified static-gate hardening was already implemented, tested, accepted and reconciled by Trigger-4 during this Trigger-6 macrocycle. Importing a new framework would add weight without current evidence of net benefit.

next_exact_action: Do not reopen WP1111 implementation. Consume its accepted repository-CI result as a bounded static prerequisite; bind/rebuild one exact deterministic release candidate and execute the accepted gate against that exact root before Trigger-4 enters real clean-machine acceptance. Keep any future live mutable-filesystem confinement as a distinct research objective.
